meanings.note: Satisfied exclamation when gearing up or finishing a task cleanly.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Adverb.

examples.text: まだ終わっていません。
まだマネジャーと話してます。
examples.trans: She's still talking with her manager.

meanings.note: 話してきます combines 話して ('talk and') with きます ('come back') to mean 'I will go talk to them and return'.

examples.text: 少し社長と話してきます。
examples.trans: I will go talk with the president for a bit.

examples.text: ゆっくり話しましょう。

そんな.gloss: such; that kind of; that much

meanings.note: Before たくさん, means 'that huge an amount'.

examples.text: そんな話は知りません。
examples.trans: I do not know such a story.

examples.text: そんな高いものは買えません。
examples.trans: I cannot buy something that expensive.

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Irregular i-adjective whose past/conditional stems use よ- (よかったら).

examples.text: よかったら来てください。

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

examples.text: そんなこといいから連れてこい。
examples.trans: Never mind that, just bring her over here.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: 監督、女優の意見もちゃんと聞いてあげてください。
examples.trans: Director, please listen properly to your actress's opinions too.

examples.text: 日本と違って、海外の女性はちゃんと自分の意見を主張するんですよ。
examples.trans: Unlike in Japan, women overseas state their own opinions clearly.

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Reassures that rules or steps are followed properly.

examples.text: ちゃんと確認しました。
ちゃんと並んでいます。

meanings.note: Follows a verb's て-form or polite お + stem (お待ちください, お持ち帰りください) to make a polite request.

examples.text: ここに書いてください。

meanings.note: Read にほん (Nihon) or にっぽん (Nippon).

examples.text: 日本の文化が好きです。

meanings.note: Alone as 違う！ or 違います, means 'No, that's wrong!'.
Refers to countries outside Japan.

examples.text: 海外旅行に行きたいです。
examples.trans: I want to go on an overseas trip.

examples.text: 海外との取り引きが増えています。

meanings.note: Reflexive pronoun pointing back to the person under discussion.

examples.text: 自分の言葉で話します。
examples.trans: I speak in my own words.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Auxiliary na-adjective expressing resemblance or conjecture.

examples.trans: It looks like it's going to rain.

examples.text: 彼は忙しいみたいですね。

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Attaches to numbers/counters (二人とも, 三人とも) to mean 'both/all of them'.

examples.text: 黒木ちゃんとの撮影の時みたいに、彼女ともちゃんと向き合ってあげてください。
examples.trans: Just like when you filmed with Kuroki, please face her sincerely too.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.
Second-person pronoun used by superiors, in songs/books, or between close friends.

examples.text: 君の意見はどうですか。
君ならきっとできるよ。
俺はね、君を尊敬しているんだ。
examples.trans: You know, I truly respect you.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).

examples.text: お前ら、観光じゃないんだからしっかりしろよ。
examples.trans: Hey, this isn't sightseeing, so pull yourselves together.

examples.text: 彼女は来るんだろうな？
ちゃんとキャストはそろってるんだろうな？
examples.trans: You've got the whole cast properly lined up, right?

meanings.note: Used for the physical world or a specific sphere/industry (この世界).

examples.text: この世界に入る覚悟はあるか。
examples.trans: Are you prepared to enter this world?

examples.text: そんな君と、世界をあっと言わせたいんだ、俺は。
examples.trans: Together with you, I want to make the whole world gasp in amazement.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

examples.text: プロの女優として、監督であるあなたの注文には応えるって。
examples.trans: She says as a professional actress, she'll meet your requests as director.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。
プロの女優として、監督であるあなたの注文には応えるって。
examples.trans: She says as a professional actress, she'll meet your requests as director.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

examples.text: がっかりさせないでよって。
examples.trans: And she says don't disappoint her.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Confident everyday word that works either before a predicate or as a standalone answer.

examples.text: もちろん手伝いますよ。

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Film/theater cue or general noun from English 'action'.

examples.text: 次のアクションを起こす。

meanings.note: Na-adjective loanword from English 'perfect'.

examples.text: 今日の発表はパーフェクトでした。
パーフェクトでございます！

meanings.note: Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
